data.name: DomeFall
data.detailed_description:
DomeFall is a 1–4 player co-op survival sandbox FPS set in a galaxy consumed by the undead. You and your squad are stranded soldiers trapped inside a fragile orbital dome — the last barrier between life and the endless rot outside. To endure, you must scavenge derelict starships, trade at alien outposts, and transform your dying habitat into a fortress of survival.

Your dome begins cracked and barren — oxygen leaking, soil lifeless, nothing but dust beneath your boots. Patch the breach, restore life support, and seed the first signs of growth. Every scavenging run is a gamble: some wrecks hold vital resources, while others swarm with horrors eager to pour into your sanctuary. Along the way, you’ll reactivate forgotten robots 🤖 — some fight beside you, while others farm, clean, and automate survival — keeping your dome alive while the galaxy decays.

There is no cure. No escape. Only survival through adaptation and growth.

Key Features

  • Co-op Survival Horror – Endure alone or with up to 3 friends as you scavenge derelict ships, trade at alien stations, and defend your dome from the undead.

  • Procedurally Generated Wrecks – No two expeditions are alike. Each derelict has shifting layouts, hidden loot, deadly hazards, and unpredictable ambushes.

  • Dome Building & Expansion – Patch breaches, spread grass and trees for oxygen, and construct farms, power grids, and automated defenses.

  • Resource Management – Balance food, water, oxygen, and power. Farm, harvest, and trade to keep your colony alive.

  • Robotic Allies – Reawaken dormant robots to fight, farm, repair, and clean. Specialize your machines to automate survival tasks.

  • Defensive Warfare – Repel zombie swarms that breach your dome and brace for catastrophic “falls” when infested hulks crash into orbit.

  • Endless Survival – The rot never stops spreading. Hold out as long as you can against the tide. ♾️

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card and microphone
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card and high-quality microphone

content_descriptors.notes:
Hullrot contains depictions of violence and horror themes. Players use firearms and melee weapons to fight against zombie enemies in dark, claustrophobic environments. Scenes may include corpses, blood, and frightening imagery such as sudden jump scares, aggressive undead attacks, and bleak survival settings.

The game does not include sexual content, depictions of sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
